bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money for a grant to Niyyah Recovery Initiative.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION. +]

[+$200,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a grant to Niyyah Recovery Initiative to fund support program costs, community engagement, staffing, and targeted high-impact outreach to expand recovery services and provide critical support to individuals affected by substance use. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2027. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money for a grant to Niyyah Recovery Initiative.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

$200,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a grant to Niyyah Recovery Initiative to fund support program costs, community engagement, staffing, and targeted high-impact outreach to expand recovery services and provide critical support to individuals affected by substance use. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2027.
additions: $200,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a grant to Niyyah Recovery Initiative to fund support program costs, community engagement, staffing, and targeted high-impact outreach to expand recovery services and provide critical support to individuals affected by substance use. This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2027.
